videos.title: How to lead when everything falls apart | Wahid Majrooh | TEDxGVAGrad
videos.author: TEDx Talks
videos.description:
Wahid Majrooh shares his experience leading Afghanistan’s health system in 2021 as Kabul collapsed. Through his personal story, he explores what true leadership means in moments of crisis, showing how presence, courage, and service can inspire hope even in the darkest times.

videos.author: TEDx Talks
videos.description:

videos.title: Conversation is a survival skill for the 21st century | Inez Robinson-Odom | TEDxSanDiegoSalon
videos.author: TEDx Talks
videos.description:
What if the skill we need most right now isn't a new technology, but an old one we've let atrophy: talking with one another? Our hardest societal challenges demand it. Civil discourse isn't a nicety for the 21st century. It's survival. This is the blueprint for the art of conversation.
